fairUse.provenance: Downloaded from the publisher product page https://www.jeuxsynapsesgames.com/products/pyramido-forgotten-treasures. The publisher product page identifies the February 2025 standalone Forgotten Treasures EN/FR game and links its rules; this box names that edition. Reduced to 360 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: Whoever went exploring most recently starts.
clarifications: Starting with that player, turns proceed clockwise.
This standalone sequel has double-sided dominoes, gems and an exploration area; it is separate from the original Pyramido.
internalEvidence: Downloaded and rendered the English PDF linked from Synapses Games’ Forgotten Treasures product page. Printed page 2 gives the exploration criterion and page 3 confirms clockwise turns. Double-sided dominoes, gems, supply bag and exploration area match inventory BGG 419793.
